name: ab-health-mcp
description: Access your Alberta Health Records and MyChart data through Claude. 44 tools for lab results, immunizations, medications, vitals, appointments, clinical documents, and more.
long_description:
Connect Claude to your Alberta health data — lab results, immunizations, medications, vitals, appointments, clinical documents, and more. Uses Alberta's official My Health Records portal and AHS MyChart (Connect Care).

On first use, Chrome opens and you log in at Alberta's real portal with your MyAlberta Digital ID. The extension fetches your data and passes it to Claude for your conversation — nothing is stored.

Requires Chrome and a MyAlberta account with My Health Records access.

DEMO_MODE.title: Demo Mode
DEMO_MODE.description: Enable demo mode with sample data — no Alberta account needed. Great for exploring what the extension can do before signing in.
